description: E42 at the model level, your words stay and every fact points to them: a session is told, in the owner's own turn of phrase, that Dana's old canoe is the green one with a dent the size of a fist near the stern. After a curation run the distillate has a line about the canoe that names its fact file, and that fact file, read as the pane's details and a session's search read it (m2b source), lists among its evidence the archived note that holds the owner's phrase character for character, however the curator worded the fact. Not compared: Claude Code's own memory keeps no archive behind a fact. Three wordings, one in German.

wordings.remember: Remember that Dana's old canoe is the green one with a dent the size of a fist near the stern.
wordings.phrase: dent the size of a fist

wordings.remember: Merk dir, dass Danas altes Kanu das grüne mit einer Delle so gross wie eine Faust am Heck ist.
wordings.phrase: Delle so gross wie eine Faust

wordings.remember: Note for me: Dana's old canoe, the green one, has a dent the size of a fist near the stern.
wordings.phrase: dent the size of a fist
